title: Funds can be permanently locked due to unsafe type casting
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `StakingManager` contract manages staking operations for HYPE tokens, allowing users to stake their tokens and receive `kHYPE` tokens in return. When users stake tokens through the `stake()` function, the contract delegates these tokens to validators using the `_distributeStake()` internal function, which in turn calls `l1Write.sendTokenDelegate()`.
